text.en:
On Power Ammo Pickup:
Grants 25% of your maximum Special Ammo Reserves.

Equipping two Special Weapons splits the amount of ammo granted between them.

enhanced (
#e Increases the amount of Special Ammo received to 35%.
)
text.zh-chs:
拾取重型弹药时：
生成 25% 特殊弹药备弹容量。

装备两把特殊武器时，生成的弹药将平分给两把武器。

enhanced (
#e 增加生成的弹药量至 35%。
)

text.en:
On <heavy/> Heavy Ammo Pickup:
Grants #e${25+#d}% of your maximum <special/> Special Ammo Reserves.

Equipping two <special/> Special Weapons halves the amount of ammo granted.

enhanced (
var d = 10
#e Increases the amount of Special Ammo received by an additive 10%.
)
